headline: Revolt Motors secures an order for 1,100 electric motorcycles from Bihar Police
hook: Electric fleet expansion for state police
summary: RattanIndia Enterprises announced that its subsidiary, Revolt Motors, has received an order to supply 1,100 electric motorcycles to the Bihar Police. This institutional contract adds to the company's order book in the electric two-wheeler segment. For retail investors, public sector fleet orders validate product adoption and provide revenue visibility for the firm's EV business.
why_it_matters: Institutional orders boost revenue visibility for RattanIndia's EV arm.
winners_losers: Revolt Motors gains / rival ICE makers hurt
